# ![splash](https://github.com/S2009-dev/MorTP/blob/main/splash.png?raw=true)

MorTP is basically a DeathSwap, a minigame originally created by SethBling where players swap positions periodically to kill each other! Unlimited players and many languages are supported.

## Supported languages

| Code    | Name                    |
|---------|-------------------------|
| `en_us` | English (United States) |
| `fr_fr` | Français (France)       |

## How to play

1. Download the [latest version](https://modrinth.com/datapack/mortp/version/1.0) of **MorTP** (ensure to download the [**required resourcepack**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/mortp/version/1.0-resources) too).
2. Move `MorTP Resources.zip` to your `resourcepacks` folder.
3. Move `MorTP v1.0.zip` to your world `datapacks` folder.
4. Apply the resourcepack to your game.
5. Create a new world with the datapack or start an existing one.
6. Run `/reload` command in chat (the datapack is loaded when you hear the experience orb sound effect).
7. You can now see a new button in your pause menu!
8. Run `/team join mortp.master` to use every [features](#features).

![pause](https://github.com/S2009-dev/MorTP/blob/main/screenshots/pause.png?raw=true)

## Features

### Game Master commands

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/function mortp:config` | Open the config menu. |
| `/function mortp:game/start` | Start the game. |
| `/function mortp:game/stop` | Stop the game. |

### Debug commands

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/function mortp:debug/start` | Start the debug mode. |
| `/function mortp:debug/stop` | Stop the debug mode. |
| `/function mortp:debug/spawn_player {id: <int>}` | Spawn a NPC with the specified id. |
